text.p: Adair International Oil and Gas Inc, reporting earnings for the fiscal year ended May 31, said Monday it restated its prior fiscal year results as a result of an independent audit.

President and chief operating officer Earl Roberts said in an interview the auditors restated and reclassified some prior year numbers mainly in connection with revenues held in escrow accounts. He added the company's form 10-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission details the changes.

Adair posted a net income of $630,000, or $0.06 a share, on revenues of $928,000 for the year ended May 31. The company said it benefitted from a non-recurring $723,000 gain, or $0.07 a share, from the cancelation of an outstanding promissory note.
This compared with a $16,000 restated loss, or $0.01 a share, on revenues of $119,000 for the year ended May 31 1996.
Adair changed its name from Roberts Oil and Gas Inc in July and named John Adair chief executive and chairman.
The company's stock dropped 1/8 to 1-1/8 Monday morning.
